dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave spline following the posterior margin from the dorsal ridge to the rounded apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius, classified as a rounded morphological peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate posterior tilt, approximately 45 degrees relative to the primary longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Horizontal base length is approximately 1.4 times the vertical peak height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, moderate convexity of the melon region with a consistent curve radius until the rostral junction.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak protruding from the melon with a length-to-base-thickness ratio of approximately 1:1.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the distinct crease where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small semicircular notch present on the lower third of the dorsal fin's trailing edge; faint linear striations visible along the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced median notch on the posterior margin of the caudal fluke; visible counter-shading gradient between the dorsal and ventral surfaces.
